text:
alex: Heads-up — ACME Health asked for a bundle of 'audit proofpoints' for SOC2/HIPAA/FedRAMP. They want a list of events we emit, signed export samples, retention proofs, and SLA exception language. Can security + legal scope this?

maria: Which regs are highest priority here? FedRAMP + HIPAA + SOC2? any Gov residency asks?

alex: All three. They explicitly called out key rotation, RBAC grants/revokes, private/VPC access, and log integrity. They want a schema sample to hand to auditors and a way to validate exports.

jonathan: We already emit many operational events, but gaps I can think of: no dedicated kms.key_rotate event, RBAC changes are in the app audit log but not normalized in the audit stream, and private deployment access (VPC console auths) live in infra logs and aren't routed to the audit pipeline.

lena: We should ship a customer-facing mapping doc + a validation checklist. Also need to propose SLA credit language when event coverage is lacking during an incident.

carter: I'll run a full inventory mapping current audit event types -> ACME requested list. ETA EOD.

alex: Can we produce a sample "signed export"? auditors want tamper-proof evidence (HMAC or KMS-signed bundle). @security-bot any constraints?

security-bot: We support KMS-backed signing of export bundles. For Private customers we require HSM/KMS configuration (KMIP or cloud KMS). Recommended endpoint: /audit/exports/signed. Sample payload structure for export bundle: ```{
  "bundle_id": "20251105-ACME-0001",
  "bundle_hash": "sha256:3f5d...",
  "signature": "kms:projects/..../keys/..../versions/1:MEUCIQ...",
  "record_count": 1240,
  "issued_at": "2025-11-05T14:12:03Z"
}``` Note: signature is an artifact from KMS Sign API. If customer wants hardware-only signing, we can wire HSM.

maria: Also need retention proof and append-only/tamper evidence. Provide signed time ranges and an index of first/last sequence numbers per day, plus ISO timestamps. Auditors ask for chain of custody and retention policy reference.

jonathan: For the event schema I'd propose the following required fields: event_type, ts (ISO), actor_id, actor_role, resource_type, resource_id, action, outcome, src_ip, trace_id, request_id. Example event: ```{
  "event_type": "rbac.role_grant",
  "ts": "2025-11-05T13:45:12Z",
  "actor_id": "svc:admin-console",
  "actor_role": "team-admin",
  "resource_type": "project",
  "resource_id": "proj-1234",
  "action": "grant_role",
  "outcome": "success",
  "src_ip": "198.51.100.23",
  "trace_id": "01-abcde-..."
}``` Make actor_role nullable but present when known — auditors usually want explicit role mapping.

lena: Legal will insist on a clause about inability to backfill missing events if the customer's collector was down or if we lost ephemeral telemetry. Suggest language: "Redwood will provide exported audit events covering the retention window; Redwood cannot guarantee backfill for client-side loss; compensatory credits apply only when Redwood's ingestion pipeline failed to persist events as documented." We should get legal to sign off.

alex: Note security concern: enabling signing via our KMS expands blast radius. If a signing key is compromised, attacker could fabricate valid bundles. We need HSM-backed keys + strict IAM (sign-only roles) + rotation + monitoring. Add to vuln triage.

carter: Inventory started: found ~70 event types in current stream. I'll output mapping to a spreadsheet and mark "missing" for: kms.rotate, rbac.role_revoke (explicit), vpc.admin_console_access.

jonathan: Proposed customer validation playbook (short): 1) Map requested events -> our mapping (explicit pass/fail) 2) Generate test events from their tenant (or simulate) 3) Export signed bundle to staging 4) Customer runs verifier suite against sample 5) Legal signs SLA exception if any gaps remain. I'll draft a playbook doc.

maria: FedRAMP specifics: must confirm US-only hosting for exported bundles and FedRAMP-High retention as requested by their GRC. Call this out separately in mapping doc.

lena: I can start a customer-facing mapping + short SLA bullets. Will include example acceptance criteria and steps for remediation. Draft by tomorrow.

alex: Great. @carter attach inventory, @jonathan draft playbook, I'll loop in compliance/legal and product for SLA language.

sre-bot: deploy: audit-export-generator v1 deployed to staging at 1765174900 :rocket:

carter: Inventory attached (will post link). Next: add checklist of production event owners for each missing type.

maria: One more vuln note — KMS-signing glue code should be fuzzed / reviewed; possible replay if timestamps trimmed. Add to triage with medium priority.

johnathan: (typo) meant 'jonathan' — will add code review to playbook.

lena: On it. Draft due tomorrow morning.

alex: Thanks all — we'll reconvene after drafts. :thumbsup:
